title: Unequal Verdicts: Investigating Gender Bias in LLM-Based Fake News Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.03627v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated fact-checking, yet their susceptibility to gender bias in this context remains underexplored. This study presents the first systematic investigation of gender bias in LLM-based fake news detection using real-world data. We augment the LIAR benchmark with three gender variants of speaker job titles (Neutral, Male, Female) for each statement to test whether veracity judgments vary solely based on gender presentation. Six state-of-the-art LLMs are evaluated across multiple bias and fairness metrics. All models exhibit gender sensitivity: 9.79%-35.13% of statements receive inconsistent labels across the three variants, with Male-Female comparisons showing 6.5%-23.6% flip rates. translated_title: 不平等的裁决：探究基于大语言模型的假新闻检测中的性别偏见
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于自动化事实核查，但其在这一场景中对性别偏见的易感性仍未得到充分研究。本研究首次利用真实世界数据对基于大语言模型的假新闻检测中的性别偏见进行了系统性调查。我们为LIAR基准数据集中的每条陈述扩充了说话者职位头衔的三种性别变体（中性、男性、女性），以测试真实性判断是否会仅因性别呈现方式而改变。研究采用多项偏见与公平性指标对六个最先进的大语言模型进行了评估。所有模型均表现出性别敏感性：9.79%-35.13%的陈述在三种变体下收到了不一致的标签，其中男性-女性比较的翻转率为6.5%-23.6%。研究识别出两种主要的偏见表现形式：不稳定性（判断不一致）和方向性（系统性偏袒）。五个模型表现出统计显著的方向性效应……
tldr: 本研究首次基于真实数据系统性揭示了基于大语言模型的假新闻检测中存在性别偏见，发现所有主流模型均表现出性别敏感性，其偏见表现为判断不稳定和系统性偏袒两种形式。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first systematic investigation of gender bias in LLM-based fake news detection using real-world data, revealing that all six state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit gender sensitivity, with bias manifested as both instability and directionality.
